paragraphs.source_en: “Could you do this for me: get tickets to the play at the Imperial Theater for the day after tomorrow for yourself and your maid.”

units.source_en: “Could you do this for me: get tickets to the play at the Imperial Theater for the day after tomorrow for yourself and your maid.”

paragraphs.source_en: The abrupt silence at the other end made Kiyoaki afraid that Satoko might refuse, but then he realized that, in his haste, there was something he had forgotten. Given the Ayakuras’ present circumstances, the price of a pair of tickets, at two yen fifty sen apiece, would represent quite an extravagance.

units.source_en: The abrupt silence at the other end made Kiyoaki afraid that Satoko might refuse, but then he realized that, in his haste, there was something he had forgotten.
Given the Ayakuras’ present circumstances, the price of a pair of tickets, at two yen fifty sen apiece, would represent quite an extravagance.

paragraphs.source_en: “No, wait, excuse me. I’ll have the tickets sent to you. If your seats are next to ours, people might talk, but I’ll arrange it so that they are somewhere nearby. I’m going with the two princes from Siam, by the way.”
